svg.text: Hope Turtle - Turtle Body full wooden slat inventory
Turtle Body v6.6.0 - generated 2026-11-12 by build/export_inventory.py from lib/ - 42 pieces - top-down views at 1:1 (print at 100 %, units mm). Caption: label - part - length x width x thickness.
Only through-face holes are shown; edge-drilled holes and blind pockets are not visible from the top. Sails (fabric) are excluded. Head fin is experimental (not built or tested).
